label: MGate MB3180 Modbus TCP gateway
description: One-port Modbus gateway that converts Modbus TCP to Modbus RTU/ASCII: a single 10/100BaseT(X) RJ45 port on the Ethernet side and one DB9 male RS-232/422/485 serial port on the field side. 16 simultaneous Modbus TCP masters, DIN-rail or wall mount, 12 to 48 VDC.
